svg.title: RH V01.12 glove: top-left row-major pixel indexing
svg.desc: Five 4 by 4 finger patches. Each cell is labelled with decoded row and column and its original pressure wire index. There are no palm sensors.
svg.text: RIGHT thin-film glove · caller assigns hand="rh"
V01.12 | Five 4×4 tactile patches | One bend channel per finger | ADC 0–4096
The GUI leaves this area blank.
Cell labels: [decoded row,column]; W = original pressure wire index. Row 0 is at the top; column 0 is at the left.
Blue example: finger_pressure["index"][9] → row 2, column 1 → pressure_raw[22]
The parser normalizes pixel order once. Bend fields already map the opposite little→thumb wire order.
